seo_desc: Fix the SEO cannibalization of your website. We merge competing pages and consolidate your B2B content to recover your organic traffic.
author_pitch: I have audited corporate websites that lost thousands of visits simply because their own pages were fighting each other on Google. I identify and merge duplicate content to create unique, unstoppable URLs.
title: Stop competing against yourself: SEO Cannibalization Solution
body:
Have your service pages dropped to the third page of Google despite constantly publishing content?

You have spent years creating articles aimed at the same service with slight variations. Now you have half a dozen different URLs trying to rank for the same keyword. This confuses the Google algorithm, which does not know which is the main page and decides to penalize all of them. Your own website is eating your organic traffic.

The trap of Publishing just to Publish

Many teams believe that generating more pages on the same topic will increase visibility, creating chaos. Having five mediocre pages competing with each other will always lose against one master page.

Our solution: Content Audit and Consolidation

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we detect where your website is sabotaging itself. We apply data engineering to unify your content into solid structures that Google understands.

  1. Forensic Cannibalization Analysis: We crawl your entire domain to identify exactly which URLs are competing for the same searches.
  2. Pillar Page Merging: We extract the best content and consolidate it into a single high-value B2B page.
  3. Surgical 301 Redirects: We permanently redirect the deleted URLs to the main page, transferring their authority.
  4. Internal Linking Restructuring: We fix your website's links so they point to the new master URL.

The Real Impact on your Organic Traffic

  • Top Rankings Recovery: By eliminating confusion, your main page climbs to the top results.
  • Higher Domain Authority: You concentrate your link equity into a few strategic URLs.
  • Conversion Rate Increase: Clients land on a robust page that answers all their questions.
